items.q: How long do our own approvals add?
items.a: Count them in your plan. Capital approval, supplier qualification and URS sign-off come before our clock starts. Your review time at each hold adds to the durations above, unless a stage says it is included.

items.q: What if our site is not ready on time?
items.a: Tell us as soon as you know. We agree a new delivery date and where the skids wait, under [storage conditions before start-up]. Storage and extra visits cost [site delay and storage charges]. The readiness checklist reaches you [site checklist before delivery, weeks] before delivery.

items.q: Can the skids wait through a Canadian winter before start-up?
items.a: Only under [storage conditions before start-up]. Frozen or dried-out reverse osmosis membranes may need replacing before start-up. Plan indoor storage if delivery comes before your room is ready.

items.q: Why a full FAT before IQ and OQ?
items.a: A fault found in our test bay costs days. A fault found on site costs your validation team's time. A complete FAT and commissioning keep IQ and OQ to testing, not troubleshooting.

items.q: What do we pay at each stage?
items.a: Payment follows events, not dates: [milestone structure]. The terms are on Buying from Aquemi.
